name: Union Bank of India
business_summary: Public-sector bank (government 74.76%) with ~Rs11 lakh cr of advances (+18.5% y/y at Sep 2026, among the fastest in large PSBs). Q2 FY27: standalone PAT Rs5,537cr (+30.3%), consolidated Rs5,781cr, NIM 2.95%, GNPA 2.42%, NII +20%, falling provisions. Raised $600m in dollar bonds in August 2026 after a 12-year gap. Estimated Rs5,500cr ECL transition impact from April 2027. Roughly half of loans repo-linked, so asset-sensitive to the October hike. Stock Rs187, P/E 6.5x, P/B ~1.0x, +23.6% in 12 months, +11% in a month.

exposures.mechanism: ~50% of Rs11 lakh cr advances (model est.; gross advances +18.5% y/y) are repo/EBLR-linked: 25bp = ~Rs1,375cr/yr = 4.7% of PBT (~Rs29,000cr); deposit repricing gives back about half over 6-12m => +2.4%; persistence 0.5 => +1.2; offset by slower-growth and treasury effects => +1. NIM is only 2.95%, so the same bp matter more than at peers.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50%, stance 'calibrated tightening', first hike in ~4 years (The Hindu 2026-10-07; Business Standard 2026-10-14: near-term cuts off the table)
MPC minutes flag more hikes but wary of an aggressive cycle (Reuters 2026-10-21)
